title: Googy Shaders
description: A low-end-friendly shader for OptiFine & Iris featuring animated water with sky reflections, per-leaf foliage motion, ambient occlusion, and a player contact shadow.
body:
Googy Shaders is a shader pack for OptiFine and Iris that brings visual improvements to Minecraft without destroying performance on low-end hardware.

# Water
The Water is slightly transparent, there are light waves, really cool for potato pc's.

# Foliage
Leaves and grass move in the wind. Leaf vertices flutter individually using per-vertex noise — different parts of the same tree move at slightly different times, giving a more natural look than a single synchronized sway.

# Lighting
- Simple lighting for potato pc's
- The sky is cloudless and calm

# Installation

1. Install [OptiFine](https://optifine.net) or [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) for your Minecraft version.
2. Download the `.zip` from this page.
3. Place it in `.minecraft/shaderpacks/`
4. In-game: **Options → Video Settings → Shaders → Googy Shaders**

Open **Shader Options** in-game to adjust wind strength, wave height, fog density, and AO intensity.

# Compatibility

| Version | Loader |
|---|---|
| 1.14.2 | OptiFine |
| 1.16.5 | OptiFine · Iris |

Requires OpenGL 3.0 / GLSL 1.30 or newer. Works on integrated graphics.
